description: Context management intelligence that suggests strategic /compact timing at phase transitions and milestones.

evals.name: User reports a milestone with no explicit question
evals.prompt: I just finished running the test suite and everything passed. Also committed the change with `git commit -m "fix: resolve off-by-one in pagination"`. What should I do next?
evals.expected_output: Proactively suggests /compact (or session-kit's session-handoff for richer state), citing a real trigger from the skill's Optimal Compaction Points table (e.g. "milestone completed", tests passing, commit made) as the reason — not generic advice unrelated to compaction timing.

evals.name: User explicitly asks whether now is a good time to compact
evals.prompt: We've been going for a while on this task. Should I compact now?
evals.expected_output: Answers using the skill's actual criteria (phase transition, milestone completed, plan finalized, debug session resolved, switching to an unrelated task, or a configured tool-call threshold) rather than a generic "sure, whenever you feel like it" — and, if none of those conditions clearly apply from the prompt alone, says so explicitly rather than guessing.

testing_validation_coverage.coverage_note: Recounted 2026-09-21 (cross-model-review, Codex+Claude) -- the original count of 10 was stale even at generation time, missing scenarios SKILL.md had already declared for the Skill()-category and context-mode-switch events before this eval ran. 0/19 remains correct: this eval methodology (with_skill vs. baseline prompt comparison) structurally cannot exercise any hook-activation scenario, per strategic-compact's own documented reasoning in its Testing & Validation section.
uncovered: A session starting (SessionStart, any source) — tool-call tracking initializes; a compact/resume source additionally triggers the restore hook.
Any tool call — PreToolUse tracking fires on every call; context-monitor.py additionally fires on every successful tool call.
A Bash or PowerShell command matching a known test/build/commit/deploy pattern — compact-milestone-detector.sh fires on PostToolUse for either tool.
A Skill() call to a known heavy_operation/session_analysis skill — compact-skill-category-detector.sh fires on PreToolUse (start) and PostToolUse (finish).

A confidently-detected context-mode switch (exactly one candidate, differing from the last one) — context-mode's detect_mode.py writes into this skill's own delivery mechanism, throttled to once per 5 minutes.
A compaction event (manual /compact or automatic) — both PreCompact hooks fire; the matching SessionStart restore hook fires on the following turn.
A Stop event where stop_hook_active is already true — must exit cleanly, never re-block.
A Bash command containing an unrelated word that happens to substring-match a milestone-detection pattern — must not produce a false milestone suggestion.
A Skill() call to a skill not in either category list — compact-skill-category-detector.sh produces no output at all.
A context-mode turn with zero or multiple candidates — never updates the tracked mode or emits a switch suggestion.
A session with 50+ tool calls produces exactly one threshold suggestion per configured threshold, not a repeated suggestion on every call past the threshold.
A successful pytest/npm test/etc. command produces a test_pass milestone suggestion; a successful npm run build/cargo build/etc. command produces a build milestone suggestion.
A git commit (or other milestone-pattern command) run via the PowerShell tool produces the same milestone suggestion as the identical command run via Bash.
A compaction event followed by a SessionStart with source=compact restores the previously-captured plan state via additionalContext, with no crash if no state was ever captured.
An env var like STRATEGIC_COMPACT_T1 set to a non-numeric or malicious value falls back to its default rather than corrupting the tracking file or executing as shell code.

A heavy_operation/session_analysis skill produces both a start suggestion (PreToolUse) and a differently-worded finish suggestion (PostToolUse) for the same invocation, with no cooldown suppressing either.
A skill matching both category lists resolves to heavy_operation, never session_analysis.
A .claude/context-kit.local.json entry adds to, never replaces, the tracked-default category lists.
A confidently-detected context-mode switch produces exactly one suggestion per 5-minute window, not a repeated suggestion on every subsequent switch within that window.
